Define one questionnaire question

Source: R/questionnaire.R
shad_question.Rd

Experimental. Creates a serializable question definition consumed by shad_questionnaire(). Conditions are named equality checks; they are data, not R or JavaScript callbacks.

Usage

shad_question(
  name,
  prompt,
  ...,
  type = c("single", "multiple", "text"),
  choices = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  required = TRUE,
  skippable = FALSE,
  show_if = NULL,
  shortcuts = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Stable question name. Names must be non-empty and unique within one questionnaire.

prompt

Question prompt rendered in the fieldset legend.

...

Reserved named HTML attributes for the question definition.

type

One of "single", "multiple", or "text".

choices

A named/unnamed vector, or a list of value/label items, required for choice questions and forbidden for text questions.

description

Optional help text.

required

If TRUE, the question must be answered before advancing.

skippable

If TRUE, the user may explicitly skip the question.

show_if

Named list of question names to accepted values. All entries must match for this question to be visible.

shortcuts

Named choice values mapped to printable keyboard keys.

Value

A serializable shad_question object.

See also

Other shadshiny questionnaire: shad_questionnaire(), update_shad_questionnaire()

Examples

shad_question(
  "plan", "What should be built?", type = "single",
  choices = c("Server table" = "data", RTL = "rtl")
)
#> $name
#> [1] "plan"
#> 
#> $prompt
#> [1] "What should be built?"
#> 
#> $attributes
#> list()
#> 
#> $type
#> [1] "single"
#> 
#> $choices
#> $choices$`Server table`
#> $choices$`Server table`$value
#> [1] "Server table"
#> 
#> $choices$`Server table`$label
#> [1] "data"
#> 
#> 
#> $choices$RTL
#> $choices$RTL$value
#> [1] "RTL"
#> 
#> $choices$RTL$label
#> [1] "rtl"
#> 
#> 
#> 
#> $description
#> NULL
#> 
#> $required
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $skippable
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $show_if
#> list()
#> 
#> $shortcuts
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_question"
